complete_examples.text: In addition, this section refers to the standard [41] to evaluate the vibration level of the system: The Z-level is weighted by 1s in dB and is expressed as: VLz = 20 log10 aʹ rms a0 (33) In which VLz is vertical vibration acceleration level (Z vibration level); a0 is the reference acceleration, which is 1 × 10−6 m/s2; aʹ rms is the effective value of vibration acceleration corrected by weighting factors at different frequencies.
